description: This Java class defines a Fragment called LogFragment that contains a LogView for displaying log data, with methods to initialize views, handle text changes, and provide access to the LogView.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that manages a LogView inside a ScrollView, providing logging display functionality.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Initializes and returns the main view hierarchy containing a ScrollView and LogView.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Overrides Fragment's method to set up the view, including adding a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on text change.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
